description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

As the Senior Director, MSSP, you will join our Channel and Alliances team and report directly to the SVP of Global Channels.

In this executive-level leadership role, you will own the commercial strategy, operational execution, and revenue quota for Zscaler's low- and no-touch sales, managed security service provider (MSSP), distribution, and aggregator business. You will build highly productive partner relationships and establish repeatable, partner-led sales motions that drive customer acquisition, expansion, and recurring revenue while drastically improving overall global sales efficiency.

Who You Are

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

 

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

  • Own Revenue & Commercial Performance: Own business planning, pipeline generation, forecasting, and performance management across new customers, expansion, and renewals for our low/no touch business. Establish clear account coverage, revenue attribution, and aligned strategic engagement plans with regional Sales leaders.
  • Scale Low- & No-Touch Sales: Build repeatable partner-led, digitally assisted, and self-service sales motions for approved customer segments and offers. Define commercial requirements for simpler buying and activation, increasing conversion and transaction volume while reducing manual intervention, sales cycle time, and cost to serve.
  • Grow the MSSP & MSP Business: Recruit, activate, and expand managed security service providers and managed service providers with the capacity to acquire and serve customers. Develop joint business plans and managed service sales plays that drive paying customer deployments, subscription or consumption growth, retention, and expansion.
  • Lead Distribution & Aggregator Growth Strategy: Own the growth strategy for our focus distributors and cloud aggregators, providing a repeatable growth platform for our in-region distribution and cloud aggregator teams translating partner reach into qualified pipeline, customer wins, and recurring revenue.
  • Lead Commercial Execution & Cross-Functional Alignment: Lead assigned sales resources and align regional Sales, Marketing, and Enablement on partner activation. Work with Global Partner Programs and technical teams on program requirements, technical requirements, policies, and incentives; drive resolution of provisioning, billing, and renewal barriers with accountable functional owners while protecting approved pricing and partner economics.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Experience: 12+ years of experience in enterprise software, cloud, or cybersecurity sales, including at least 5 years leading a quota-carrying partner business or sales team.
  • Quota & Pipeline Track Record: Proven success meeting or exceeding revenue targets and building predictable pipeline, accurate forecasts, and recurring revenue through indirect routes to market.
  • Ecosystem Expertise: Substantial commercial experience with distributors and MSP or MSSP ecosystems, including executive partner relationships, joint business planning, and downstream partner activation.
  • Analytical Capabilities: Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage tools like Crossbeam, Salesforce, and others to reinforce the strategic approach with data-driven analytics. (Note: Analytical support is available, but this role requires data-driven self-sufficiency).
  • Business Model Acumen: Experience building low- and no-touch sales motions, with a strong understanding of subscription and consumption economics, partner profitability, and the customer lifecycle.
  • Leadership & Influence: Experience leading sales teams, with the commercial judgment and executive influence to drive decisions across Sales, Partner Programs, Product, Finance, and Operations.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Direct experience establishing or scaling MSSP aggregator or comparable cloud aggregator and marketplace relationships, including activating downstream MSPs.
  • Experience growing cybersecurity or cloud security businesses through managed services, distribution, or digital sales channels across multiple regions.
  • The Builder Mindset: Although existing MSSP and distribution motions exist at scale here at Zscaler, we are a very driven, builder-focused company. You have a documented track record of pioneering these motions from early initiation through to enterprise-wide scale.
  • A track record of improving partner productivity and sales efficiency through automation, repeatable sales plays, and data-driven management of conversion, time to revenue, and cost to serve.
